page.layout: One page. At the top, a centred title above a tree-shaped outline (diagram) that fills most of the page. A rotated label runs up the left margin beside the outermost brace. Below the diagram, "FINIS." is centred. A catchword sits at the lower right, and a digitiser stamp at the bottom right is left out.

main_text.head: Tabula Technologiæ Methodum adumbrans:
main_text.l: C. Differentiæ secundum quas sit liberalis scientiæ alia est [?]
à prima orta, quæ est, vel
Minus principa-lis: quæ Philolo-gica dicitur: Estque vel

page.notes: The diagram is an outline: each box is one line, with depth taken from the braces. The rotated label on the left reads upward and its last word is uncertain. "Divisio:" is partly hidden by the box "Simplex" and is uncertain. The braces link "contemplativa, operatiua" to "Actiua, effectiua" under "totalis", and the braces under "Sapientia" and "Eloquentia" are read as drawn. No page number, running head or signature is printed.
